note: A six-ingredient granola. The ingredients are named by FoodData Central id so the numbers cannot drift when a description changes. The expected values below are what 21 CFR 101.9(c) rounding produces from the USDA figures in data/foods.json; browser_test.py drives the page with this input and checks them on the drawn panel.

items.desc: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry

input.ingredient_statement: INGREDIENTS: ROLLED OATS, HONEY, SUNFLOWER OIL, ALMONDS, SUNFLOWER SEEDS, SALT.

expect.sodium_rounding: Sodium is 85 mg. 21 CFR 101.9(c)(4) puts values above 5 mg and up to 140 mg on the nearest 5 mg, so a 5 mg increment is the right one here and 10 mg would be wrong.
